pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp edge gradients. Geometry consists of non-uniform quadrilaterals and pentagons with slight curvature at vertices. Relative spatial area is largest on the mid-flank, diminishing in size toward the ventral and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial connectivity. Pixel thickness remains relatively constant across the mid-lateral view, narrowing slightly at the junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristly silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. Individual hair follicles create a consistent jagged 1D contour against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (Buphagus sp.) perched on the dorsal ridge, characterized by a dark-toned body and a distinct red/orange focal point corresponding to the beak or orbital ring.
